I'd like to share the current version of [`leanView`](https://github.com/syjn99/leanView) in five minutes, while getting some mandatory information for upcoming devnets.

Related issue: https://github.com/leanEthereum/pm/issues/40
Would love to just say a word about lean-ssz: https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanSpec/tree/main/src/lean_spec/subspecs/ssz

I may briefly (2 mins) update on our devnet client which we just open sourced https://github.com/qdrvm/qlean-mini

At the moment we have: ssz, block production, networking (gossipsub 1.0 - 1.2).
The team is working hard on adding docker image, STF, and 3SF by the mid of next week
